#!/usr/bin/env bash
# L20: fcsr (frm + sticky fflags) round-trips QEMU1 -> vsim -> drain.
#
# rt_c_fcsr sets fcsr=0x21 (frm=RTZ | NX) before the enter marker; the
# plugin must drain it (state file offset 3408, locked by
# state_abi_check.h). The vsim leg's in-ROI self-check exits 1 if
# ResumeDriver did not restore the value, then writes the sentinel 0x45
# (frm=RDN | NX|UF) that StateDrain must capture at the exit marker.
#
# Manual TDD smoke; not auto-wired into scripts/run_e2e.sh (the fixture
# itself runs there via the normal marker/pc suite).

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-rt_c_fcsr}"
TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-120}"

hybrid_resolve_paths

SHARED_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
SHARED_MEM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-fcsr-shared.XXXXXX)
STATE_QEMU=$(mktemp)
STATE_VSIM=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$SHARED_MEM" "$STATE_QEMU" "$STATE_VSIM"' EXIT
truncate -s "$SHARED_SIZE" "$SHARED_MEM"

read_u64_le() { od -A n -j "$1" -N 8 -t u8 "$2" | tr -d ' \n'; }
FCSR_OFF=3408  # locked by include/hybrid/state_abi_check.h

set +e
"$VSIM_QEMU" \
  -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHARED_MEM,size=$SHARED_SIZE" \
  -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
  -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512 \
  -nographic \
  -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
  -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,outfile=$STATE_QEMU" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
QEMU1_RC=$?
set -e
[ "$QEMU1_RC" -eq 200 ] || fail "QEMU 1 expected exit 200 on marker drain, got $QEMU1_RC"
[ -s "$STATE_QEMU" ]    || fail "QEMU 1 produced no state"

Q_FCSR=$(read_u64_le "$FCSR_OFF" "$STATE_QEMU")
[ "$Q_FCSR" -eq 33 ] \
  || fail "QEMU 1 drained fcsr=$Q_FCSR, want 33 (0x21: frm=RTZ | NX) -- plugin not draining fcsr?"
ok "QEMU 1 drained fcsr=0x21"

set +e
timeout "$TIMEOUT" "$VSIM_BIN" "$VSIM_ELF" \
  --resume-from-qemu "$STATE_QEMU" \
  --handoff-out "$STATE_VSIM" \
  --shared-mem-path "$SHARED_MEM" \
  --shared-mem-size "$SHARED_SIZE" \
  --shared-mem-base 0x00000000 </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
VSIM_RC=$?
set -e
[ "$VSIM_RC" -ne 1 ] \
  || fail "vsim leg exited 1: the fixture's in-ROI self-check saw fcsr != 0x21 (ResumeDriver not restoring fcsr?)"
[ "$VSIM_RC" -eq 200 ] || fail "vsim expected exit 200 (marker drain), got $VSIM_RC"
[ -s "$STATE_VSIM" ]   || fail "vsim produced no state"
ok "vsim in-ROI self-check passed (fcsr restored)"

V_FCSR=$(read_u64_le "$FCSR_OFF" "$STATE_VSIM")
[ "$V_FCSR" -eq 69 ] \
  || fail "vsim drained fcsr=$V_FCSR, want 69 (0x45: frm=RDN | NX|UF) -- StateDrain not reading fcsr back?"
ok "vsim drain captured the in-ROI fcsr sentinel 0x45"

echo "PASS e2e_fcsr_roundtrip"

 * enter_vsim()/exit_vsim() span therefore works on vsim too -- it just
 * adds its real cycles (UART polling, dcache flush) to the measured
 * figure, so cycle-measuring fixtures keep the span syscall-free by
 * choice, not by rule.
 */

#ifndef RT_C_HELPERS_H
#define RT_C_HELPERS_H

/* Plugin- / handoff-controller-recognized drain markers: the HINT pair
 * `slti x0, x0, 0x5A0` (ENTER) / `slti x0, x0, 0x5A1` (EXIT). Match
 * insn_match.h. rd=x0 makes each marker an architectural NOP, so marked
 * binaries also run standalone on every engine.
 *
 * marker mode pattern-matches the HINT insns directly; the helpers do not
 * export any `_hybrid_*_pc` symbol. PC-trigger callers pass the switch PCs
 * explicitly via `--pc-start`/`--pc-end` (or the env-var pair
 * `ROI_START`/`ROI_END`); see tests/lib/roi.sh. */

 * (e.g. &_impure_ptr) into a callee-saved register across the marker and
 * use it after resume; if vsim doesn't faithfully restore that register
 * the post-resume code dereferences garbage. The clobber list deliberately
 * does NOT include GPRs: the round-trip is required to preserve them. */

 * on the Andes GCC at -O2/-O3: an out-of-line marker does NOT help -- a

# Build tiny RV64 fixtures used by hybrid smoke tests.
#
# Toolchain location comes from the repo-root config.env (loaded by
# `source ./setup.sh`, which exports HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN). Override on the
# command line with `make TOOLCHAIN=/path/to/toolchain ...` if you want
# to bypass the env var.

TOOLCHAIN ?= $(HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN)
ifeq ($(strip $(TOOLCHAIN)),)
$(error HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN is not set. Run `source ./setup.sh` from the repo root, or pass `TOOLCHAIN=/path/to/toolchain` on the command line)
endif
CC        := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc
LD        := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-ld
OBJDUMP   := $(TOOLCHAIN)/bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-objdump

# Runtime sources live at the repo root (runtime/) -- they are the
# user-facing andes-sim runtime; fixtures are just one consumer. The linker
# script moved with them (test.ld -> runtime/andes-sim.ld, same content).
RUNTIME_DIR := ../../runtime
LDSCRIPT    := $(RUNTIME_DIR)/andes-sim.ld
# Fixture-only helpers (csr ROI markers; NOT part of the portable runtime).
HELPERS_DIR := runtime

CFLAGS  := -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -nostdlib -static -Wall
LDFLAGS := -T $(LDSCRIPT) -nostdlib -static

# All fixtures share andes-sim.ld (load base 0x00100000, andes_ae350 DRAM).
RT_FIXTURES := rt_all_gprs rt_abi_aliases rt_sign_bits rt_pc_jump \
               rt_long_roi rt_mem_loadstore rt_unaligned_lh \
               rt_shared_mem rt_csr_survival

# C-level fixtures: standard newlib stdio (printf, fputs, ...) linked
# through the shipped vplat runtime (libandes_sim_runtime.a) with the
# same two-flag command users type (-B build/runtime
# -specs=andes-sim.specs), so the suites regression-test the real
# artifact. stdio goes out the ATCUART100 UART2 and exit/file-io through
# the SimControl device at 0xe0080000, all of which both QEMU's
# andes_ae350 and vsim model. No semihosting and no libgloss anywhere:
# vplat_syscalls.o in the archive provides every stub newlib needs, so
# the same ELF runs on fast, cycle AND hybrid and a syscall inside the
# ROI works (it just adds its real cycles to the figure).
RT_C_FIXTURES    := rt_c_hello rt_c_printf rt_c_matmul rt_c_static_buf \
                    rt_c_no_trigger_exit rt_c_fcsr
RT_C_V_FIXTURES  := rt_c_v_regs rt_c_v_csrs rt_c_v_matmul
RT_C_VPLAT_FIXTURES := vplat_hello vplat_exit41 vplat_file

RUNTIME_SRCS    := $(RUNTIME_DIR)/crt0.S $(RUNTIME_DIR)/trap.S \
                   $(RUNTIME_DIR)/handler.c
VPLAT_RT_DIR := ../../build/runtime
VPLAT_RT     := $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/libandes_sim_runtime.a $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/crt0.o \
                $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/andes-sim.ld $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/andes-sim.specs \
                $(VPLAT_RT_DIR)/include/andes_sim/roi.h
VPLAT_CFLAGS := -march=rv64gc -mabi=lp64d -O1 -Wall
# RVV-using fixtures need -march=rv64gcv; the runtime's rv64gc objects
# link cleanly into rv64gcv programs (ld unions the arch attributes).
# The crt0 already sets mstatus.VS to Initial, so V insns don't trap.
VPLAT_V_CFLAGS := -march=rv64gcv -mabi=lp64d -O1 -Wall

.PHONY: all clean dump

all: spin.elf icount_spin.elf handoff.elf handoff_exit.elf handoff_roundtrip.elf \
     $(RT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) $(RT_C_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) \
     $(RT_C_V_FIXTURES:%=%.elf) rt_c_v_matmul_free.elf \
     $(RT_C_VPLAT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf)

# Note: handoff.elf, handoff_exit.elf, spin.elf are referenced only by the
# EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL handoff_smoke.cpp target; they still build here for
# completeness. All targets share andes-sim.ld at 0x00100000.

spin.elf: spin.S $(LDSCRIPT)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c spin.S -o spin.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) spin.o -o $@

# CSR-less spin for F5 plugin-icount e2e. Linked at 0x00100000 (andes-sim.ld)
# so andes_ae350's MROM at 0x80000000 stays clear when loaded via -bios.
icount_spin.elf: icount_spin.S $(LDSCRIPT)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c icount_spin.S -o icount_spin.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) icount_spin.o -o $@

handoff.elf: handoff.S $(LDSCRIPT)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c handoff.S -o handoff.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) handoff.o -o $@

handoff_exit.elf: handoff_exit.S $(LDSCRIPT)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c handoff_exit.S -o handoff_exit.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) handoff_exit.o -o $@

handoff_roundtrip.elf: handoff_roundtrip.S $(LDSCRIPT) semihost_exit.inc
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c handoff_roundtrip.S -o handoff_roundtrip.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) handoff_roundtrip.o -o $@

$(RT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf): %.elf: %.S $(LDSCRIPT) semihost_exit.inc
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $*.o
	$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) $*.o -o $@

# C-level fixtures: linked exactly like a user program (see VPLAT_RT
# above). rt_c_helpers.h rides -I$(HELPERS_DIR).
$(RT_C_FIXTURES:%=%.elf): %.elf: %.c $(VPLAT_RT) $(HELPERS_DIR)/rt_c_helpers.h
	$(CC) $(VPLAT_CFLAGS) -I$(HELPERS_DIR) \
	  -B $(VPLAT_RT_DIR) -specs=andes-sim.specs $< -o $@

# RVV-enabled fixtures: same link, different -march. Listed separately so
# changes to VPLAT_CFLAGS don't accidentally drop V.
$(RT_C_V_FIXTURES:%=%.elf): %.elf: %.c $(VPLAT_RT) $(HELPERS_DIR)/rt_c_helpers.h
	$(CC) $(VPLAT_V_CFLAGS) -I$(HELPERS_DIR) \
	  -B $(VPLAT_RT_DIR) -specs=andes-sim.specs $< -o $@

# vplat smoke fixtures (tests/vplat/): exercise the runtime's own
# features (exit code, file io) with no fixture helpers.
$(RT_C_VPLAT_FIXTURES:%=%.elf): %.elf: %.c $(VPLAT_RT)
	$(CC) $(VPLAT_CFLAGS) -B $(VPLAT_RT_DIR) -specs=andes-sim.specs $< -o $@

# One sub-make produces all five artifacts (grouped target, make >= 4.3).
$(VPLAT_RT) &: $(RUNTIME_SRCS) $(RUNTIME_DIR)/vplat_syscalls.c \
               $(RUNTIME_DIR)/andes-sim.ld $(RUNTIME_DIR)/andes-sim.specs \
               $(RUNTIME_DIR)/roi.h
	$(MAKE) -C $(RUNTIME_DIR)

# Markerless GEMM twin (gemm_modes.md F2). Explicit rule, NOT in
# RT_C_V_FIXTURES -- the pattern rule would look for a nonexistent
# rt_c_v_matmul_free.c. Same source, same link as the marked V fixtures,
# plus -DHYBRID_MARKERLESS (drops the ROI marker HINTs).
rt_c_v_matmul_free.elf: rt_c_v_matmul.c $(VPLAT_RT) $(HELPERS_DIR)/rt_c_helpers.h
	$(CC) $(VPLAT_V_CFLAGS) -DHYBRID_MARKERLESS -I$(HELPERS_DIR) \
	  -B $(VPLAT_RT_DIR) -specs=andes-sim.specs rt_c_v_matmul.c -o $@

dump: spin.elf handoff.elf handoff_exit.elf
	$(OBJDUMP) -d spin.elf
	$(OBJDUMP) -d handoff.elf
	$(OBJDUMP) -d handoff_exit.elf

clean:
	rm -f spin.o spin.elf handoff.o handoff.elf handoff_exit.o handoff_exit.elf \

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# L11: a VLEN-1024 engine drains its full V registers -- no silent clamp.
#
# rt_c_v_fill fills v8 with 0xA5 across all vlenb bytes before the enter
# marker. The QEMU leg runs at vlen=1024 (vlenb=128, twice the old 64-byte
# wire ceiling); the plugin must drain vlenb=128 and the WHOLE register:
# the last byte of v8's slot would read 0 under the old clamp.
#
# Also pins the fast-standalone override surface: a user-supplied trailing
# `-cpu` (after `--`) replaces the built-in vlen=512, so
# `andes-sim run --model fast` covers VLEN 128..1024 without a new flag.
#
# Manual TDD smoke; not auto-wired into scripts/run_e2e.sh (the fixture
# itself runs there via the normal marker/pc suite at the engine VLEN).

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-rt_c_v_fill}"
TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-120}"

hybrid_resolve_paths

SHARED_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
SHARED_MEM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-vlen1024-shared.XXXXXX)
STATE_QEMU=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$SHARED_MEM" "$STATE_QEMU"' EXIT
truncate -s "$SHARED_SIZE" "$SHARED_MEM"

read_u64_le() { od -A n -j "$1" -N 8 -t u8 "$2" | tr -d ' \n'; }
read_u8()     { od -A n -j "$1" -N 1 -t u1 "$2" | tr -d ' \n'; }
# Offsets locked by include/hybrid/state_abi_check.h (ceiling 128).
VLENB_OFF=1312
V8_FIRST=$((1320 + 8 * 128))        # vreg[8 * HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX]
V8_LAST=$((V8_FIRST + 127))         # byte 127: only present un-clamped

set +e
"$VSIM_QEMU" \
  -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHARED_MEM,size=$SHARED_SIZE" \
  -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
  -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=1024 \
  -nographic \
  -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
  -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,outfile=$STATE_QEMU" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
QEMU1_RC=$?
set -e
[ "$QEMU1_RC" -eq 200 ] || fail "QEMU 1 expected exit 200 on marker drain, got $QEMU1_RC"
[ -s "$STATE_QEMU" ]    || fail "QEMU 1 produced no state"

Q_VLENB=$(read_u64_le "$VLENB_OFF" "$STATE_QEMU")
[ "$Q_VLENB" -eq 128 ] \
  || fail "drained vlenb=$Q_VLENB, want 128 (VLEN 1024)"
ok "QEMU 1 drained vlenb=128 (VLEN 1024)"

B_FIRST=$(read_u8 "$V8_FIRST" "$STATE_QEMU")
B_LAST=$(read_u8 "$V8_LAST" "$STATE_QEMU")
[ "$B_FIRST" -eq 165 ] \
  || fail "v8 byte 0 = $B_FIRST, want 165 (0xA5) -- V drain broken?"
[ "$B_LAST" -eq 165 ] \
  || fail "v8 byte 127 = $B_LAST, want 165 (0xA5) -- upper half clamped (old 64-byte ceiling)?"
ok "v8 drained un-truncated across all 128 bytes"

# Fast-standalone surface: trailing -cpu (passthrough after --) overrides
# the built-in vlen=512; the fixture's self-check runs inline (markers are
# NOPs on the fast model) and main returns 0.
set +e
timeout "$TIMEOUT" "$TOP_ROOT/andes-sim" run --model fast "$VSIM_ELF" \
  -- -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=1024 </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
FAST_RC=$?
set -e
[ "$FAST_RC" -eq 0 ] \
  || fail "fast standalone at vlen=1024 exited $FAST_RC, want 0"
ok "fast standalone runs at vlen=1024 via trailing -cpu"

echo "PASS e2e_vlen1024_drain"

# Run the hybrid e2e tests directly, bypassing the VSIM_ENABLE_HYBRID
# CTest gate. Drives tests/*.sh against pre-built artifacts in this
# workspace.
#
# Env overrides:
#   VSIM_QEMU    qemu-system-riscv64 (default: build/qemu/qemu-system-riscv64)
#   VSIM_PLUGIN  libhybrid_handoff.so (default: qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so)
#   VSIM_BIN     sim_<cpu> (default: first sim_* under verilator/build/)
#   FILTER       regex; only run tests whose name matches
#   MODE         marker | pc | both  (default: both) - drives TRIGGER_MODE
#                for round-trip fixtures. Negative drivers run once
#                regardless because they assert orchestrator failure
#                modes orthogonal to the trigger mechanism.
#   JOBS         parallel job slots (default: min($(nproc),
#                free(/dev/shm)/256MB)). Each Tier-2 slot uses a 128 MB
#                /dev/shm mmap and runs 2 processes (qemu1, vsim); the
#                headroom check leaves margin for that plus QEMU's own
#                scratch. Pass JOBS=1 for sequential semantics.
#   LOG_DIR      where per-test logs land (default: mktemp -d under /tmp)

set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
VSIM_DIR="$ROOT/verilator"
HARNESS="$ROOT/tests"
TEST_DIR="$ROOT/tests/fixtures"

VSIM_QEMU="${VSIM_QEMU:-$ROOT/build/qemu/qemu-system-riscv64}"
VSIM_PLUGIN="${VSIM_PLUGIN:-$ROOT/qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so}"

  # pins). The fixtures are single-hart programs: on a multicore build like
  # sim_ax45mpv_mp2 -- which sorts FIRST under verilator/build/ -- the
  # secondary hart runs crt0 from reset, writes SKIPPED to SimControl and
  # stops the sim before hart 0 drains, failing every C fixture. Fall back
  # to the first sim_* only when the canonical engine is not built.
  VSIM_BIN="$VSIM_DIR/build/sim_ax45mpv_premium"
  if [[ ! -x "$VSIM_BIN" ]]; then
    VSIM_BIN=$(ls "$VSIM_DIR"/build/sim_* 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  fi
fi

step() { printf '\033[1;34m==>\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
ok()   { printf '\033[1;32m[ok]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
warn() { printf '\033[1;33m[skip]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
fail() { printf '\033[1;31m[FAIL]\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

require() {
  if [[ -z "$2" || ! -e "$2" ]]; then
    fail "$1 not found: $2"
    fail "build artifacts first: 'source ./setup.sh'"
    exit 1
  fi
}

require VSIM_PLUGIN "$VSIM_PLUGIN"
require VSIM_BIN    "$VSIM_BIN"

export VSIM_QEMU VSIM_PLUGIN VSIM_BIN

REQUIRED_ELFS=(
  handoff_roundtrip rt_pc_jump rt_sign_bits rt_abi_aliases rt_long_roi
  rt_all_gprs rt_mem_loadstore rt_unaligned_lh rt_csr_survival rt_shared_mem
  rt_c_hello rt_c_printf rt_c_matmul rt_c_fcsr rt_c_v_regs rt_c_v_csrs
  rt_c_v_matmul
  # CSR-less spin loop; used by `./andes-sim run --mode icount` and the BBV-emit
  # / SimPoint stages.
  icount_spin
)
need_build=0
for f in "${REQUIRED_ELFS[@]}"; do
  [[ -e "$TEST_DIR/$f.elf" ]] || need_build=1
done
if (( need_build )); then
  step "building test ELFs in $TEST_DIR"
  make -C "$TEST_DIR" -j
fi

# e2e.sh harness (shared /dev/shm mmap). The TRIGGER_MODE env is
# injected per iteration based on $MODE. Negative drivers live in
# NEG_TESTS and run once regardless of mode.

  "handoff_roundtrip|FIXTURE=handoff_roundtrip"
  "rt_pc_jump|FIXTURE=rt_pc_jump"
  "rt_sign_bits|FIXTURE=rt_sign_bits"
  "rt_abi_aliases|FIXTURE=rt_abi_aliases"
  "rt_long_roi|FIXTURE=rt_long_roi"
  "rt_all_gprs|FIXTURE=rt_all_gprs"
  "rt_mem_loadstore|FIXTURE=rt_mem_loadstore"
  "rt_unaligned_lh|FIXTURE=rt_unaligned_lh"
  "rt_csr_survival|FIXTURE=rt_csr_survival"
  "rt_shared_mem|FIXTURE=rt_shared_mem"
  "rt_c_hello|FIXTURE=rt_c_hello"
  "rt_c_printf|FIXTURE=rt_c_printf"
  "rt_c_matmul|FIXTURE=rt_c_matmul TIMEOUT=120"
  "rt_c_fcsr|FIXTURE=rt_c_fcsr"
  "rt_c_v_regs|FIXTURE=rt_c_v_regs"
  "rt_c_v_csrs|FIXTURE=rt_c_v_csrs"
  "rt_c_v_matmul|FIXTURE=rt_c_v_matmul TIMEOUT=120"
  "rt_c_static_buf|FIXTURE=rt_c_static_buf"
)

NEG_TESTS=(
  "rt_corrupt_state|bash $HARNESS/drivers/rt_corrupt_state.sh"
)

MODE="${MODE:-both}"
case "$MODE" in
  marker|pc|both) ;;
  *) fail "MODE must be one of marker|pc|both (got: $MODE)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

default_jobs() {
  local n=1 shm_free shm_cap
  n=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 1)

    shm_free=$(df -m --output=avail /dev/shm 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | tr -d ' ')

      (( shm_cap < n && shm_cap >= 1 )) && n=$shm_cap

  fi
  (( n < 1 )) && n=1
  printf '%d\n' "$n"
}

[[ "$JOBS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$JOBS" -ge 1 ]] \
  || { fail "JOBS must be a positive integer (got: $JOBS)"; exit 1; }

RESULTS_FILE="$LOG_DIR/results.tsv"
LOCK_FILE="$LOG_DIR/lock"
: > "$RESULTS_FILE"
: > "$LOCK_FILE"

# run_one MODE NAME CMD INDEX TOTAL
# Captures the test command's stdout+stderr into $LOG_DIR/$mode--$name.log,
# emits one atomic progress line, and appends a TSV row to $RESULTS_FILE
# (mode<TAB>name<TAB>status<TAB>rc<TAB>elapsed). flock on $LOCK_FILE
# serializes the progress write and the results-file append so concurrent
# children (introduced by the parallel-execution commit) cannot interleave
# their TTY writes or corrupt the tally file.
run_one() {
  local mode="$1" name="$2" cmd="$3" idx="$4" total="$5"
  local log="$LOG_DIR/$mode--$name.log"
  local start end elapsed status rc
  start=$(date +%s)
  set +e
  bash -c "$cmd" >"$log" 2>&1
  rc=$?
  set -e
  end=$(date +%s)
  elapsed=$((end - start))
  case $rc in
    0)  status=PASS ;;
    77) status=SKIP ;;
    *)  status=FAIL ;;
  esac
  (
    flock 9
    case "$status" in
      PASS) ok   "[$idx/$total] ${name}[${mode}] (${elapsed}s)" ;;
      SKIP) warn "[$idx/$total] ${name}[${mode}] (rc=77, ${elapsed}s)" ;;
      FAIL) fail "[$idx/$total] ${name}[${mode}] (rc=$rc, ${elapsed}s) -> $log" ;;
    esac
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%d\t%d\n' \
      "$mode" "$name" "$status" "$rc" "$elapsed" >> "$RESULTS_FILE"
  ) 9>"$LOCK_FILE"
}

# Build the workplan: one entry per (mode, name, cmd) tuple. Order
# matters: marker-mode tests first, then pc-mode, then negatives (matching
# the original sequential layout so logs are streamed in the same order).
declare -a WORKPLAN=()
for tm in marker pc; do
  [[ "$MODE" != "both" && "$MODE" != "$tm" ]] && continue
  for entry in "${RT_TESTS[@]}"; do
    rt_name="${entry%%|*}"
    env_prefix="${entry#*|}"
    # B3: anchor the regex so FILTER=rt_csr does not silently also match
    # rt_csr_survival. Users who want a substring match pass '.*marker.*'.
    [[ -n "$FILTER" && ! "$rt_name" =~ ^$FILTER$ ]] && continue
    cmd="TRIGGER_MODE=$tm $env_prefix bash $HARNESS/e2e.sh"
    WORKPLAN+=("$tm|$rt_name|$cmd")
  done
done
for entry in "${NEG_TESTS[@]}"; do
  neg_name="${entry%%|*}"
  neg_cmd="${entry#*|}"
  [[ -n "$FILTER" && ! "$neg_name" =~ ^$FILTER$ ]] && continue
  WORKPLAN+=("neg|$neg_name|$neg_cmd")
done

TOTAL=${#WORKPLAN[@]}
step "logs: $LOG_DIR  jobs: $JOBS  mode: $MODE  tests: $TOTAL"

# FIFO-based bounded job pool. Each child reads one token from $SEM_FIFO
# before starting and writes one back on exit; only $JOBS tokens exist,
# so at most $JOBS children run concurrently. Opening the fifo in
# read-write mode (<>) means writes never block the parent. The fifo
# inode is unlinked immediately after fd 8 is bound -- the kernel keeps
# the pipe alive as long as fd 8 is open.
SEM_FIFO="$LOG_DIR/sem.fifo"
mkfifo "$SEM_FIFO"
exec 8<>"$SEM_FIFO"
rm -f "$SEM_FIFO"
for ((sem_i=0; sem_i<JOBS; sem_i++)); do
  printf '.\n' >&8
done

i=0
for w in "${WORKPLAN[@]}"; do
  i=$((i+1))
  w_mode="${w%%|*}"
  w_rest="${w#*|}"
  w_name="${w_rest%%|*}"
  w_cmd="${w_rest#*|}"
  read -r -u 8 _tok
  (
    run_one "$w_mode" "$w_name" "$w_cmd" "$i" "$TOTAL"
    printf '.\n' >&8
  ) &
done
wait
exec 8>&-

declare -A MODE_PASS=([marker]=0 [pc]=0 [neg]=0)
declare -A MODE_FAIL=([marker]=0 [pc]=0 [neg]=0)
declare -A MODE_SKIP=([marker]=0 [pc]=0 [neg]=0)
declare -a FAILED_NAMES=()
while IFS=$'\t' read -r r_mode r_name r_status _r_rc _r_el; do
  case "$r_status" in
    PASS) MODE_PASS[$r_mode]=$((MODE_PASS[$r_mode]+1)) ;;
    SKIP) MODE_SKIP[$r_mode]=$((MODE_SKIP[$r_mode]+1)) ;;
    FAIL) MODE_FAIL[$r_mode]=$((MODE_FAIL[$r_mode]+1));
          FAILED_NAMES+=("${r_name}[${r_mode}]") ;;
  esac
done < "$RESULTS_FILE"

# Stream failed-test logs in workplan order so the user sees a
# deterministic post-run failure dump.
for w in "${WORKPLAN[@]}"; do
  w_mode="${w%%|*}"
  w_rest="${w#*|}"
  w_name="${w_rest%%|*}"
  w_status=$(awk -F'\t' -v m="$w_mode" -v n="$w_name" \
                 '$1==m&&$2==n{print $3; exit}' "$RESULTS_FILE")
  if [[ "$w_status" == "FAIL" ]]; then
    echo
    echo "=== FAIL log: ${w_name}[${w_mode}] ==="
    cat "$LOG_DIR/$w_mode--$w_name.log"
  fi
done

echo
marker_p=${MODE_PASS[marker]} marker_f=${MODE_FAIL[marker]} marker_s=${MODE_SKIP[marker]}
pc_p=${MODE_PASS[pc]}   pc_f=${MODE_FAIL[pc]}   pc_s=${MODE_SKIP[pc]}
neg_p=${MODE_PASS[neg]} neg_f=${MODE_FAIL[neg]} neg_s=${MODE_SKIP[neg]}
total_pass=$((marker_p + pc_p + neg_p))
total_fail=$((marker_f + pc_f + neg_f))
total_skip=$((marker_s + pc_s + neg_s))
step "summary: marker ${marker_p}p/${marker_f}f/${marker_s}s  pc ${pc_p}p/${pc_f}f/${pc_s}s  neg ${neg_p}p/${neg_f}f/${neg_s}s  total ${total_pass} passed, ${total_fail} failed, ${total_skip} skipped"
if (( total_fail > 0 )); then
  fail "failures: ${FAILED_NAMES[*]}"
  exit 1
fi

# (mode<TAB>name<TAB>status<TAB>rc<TAB>elapsed). flock on $LOCK_FILE
# serializes the progress write and the results-file append so concurrent
# children (introduced by the parallel-execution commit) cannot interleave
# their TTY writes or corrupt the tally file.
run_one() {
  local mode="$1" name="$2" cmd="$3" idx="$4" total="$5"
  local log="$LOG_DIR/$mode--$name.log"
  local start end elapsed status rc
  start=$(date +%s)
  set +e
  bash -c "$cmd" >"$log" 2>&1
  rc=$?
  set -e
  end=$(date +%s)
  elapsed=$((end - start))
  case $rc in
    0)  status=PASS ;;
    77) status=SKIP ;;
    *)  status=FAIL ;;
  esac
  (
    flock 9
    case "$status" in
      PASS) ok   "[$idx/$total] ${name}[${mode}] (${elapsed}s)" ;;
      SKIP) warn "[$idx/$total] ${name}[${mode}] (rc=77, ${elapsed}s)" ;;
      FAIL) fail "[$idx/$total] ${name}[${mode}] (rc=$rc, ${elapsed}s) -> $log" ;;
    esac
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%d\t%d\n' \
      "$mode" "$name" "$status" "$rc" "$elapsed" >> "$RESULTS_FILE"
  ) 9>"$LOCK_FILE"
}

# Build the workplan: one entry per (mode, name, cmd) tuple. Order
# matters: marker-mode tests first, then pc-mode, then negatives (matching
# the original sequential layout so logs are streamed in the same order).
declare -a WORKPLAN=()
for tm in marker pc; do
  [[ "$MODE" != "both" && "$MODE" != "$tm" ]] && continue
  for entry in "${RT_TESTS[@]}"; do
    rt_name="${entry%%|*}"
    env_prefix="${entry#*|}"
    # B3: anchor the regex so FILTER=rt_csr does not silently also match
    # rt_csr_survival. Users who want a substring match pass '.*marker.*'.
    [[ -n "$FILTER" && ! "$rt_name" =~ ^$FILTER$ ]] && continue
    cmd="TRIGGER_MODE=$tm $env_prefix bash $HARNESS/e2e.sh"
    WORKPLAN+=("$tm|$rt_name|$cmd")
  done
done
for entry in "${NEG_TESTS[@]}"; do
  neg_name="${entry%%|*}"
  neg_cmd="${entry#*|}"
  [[ -n "$FILTER" && ! "$neg_name" =~ ^$FILTER$ ]] && continue
  WORKPLAN+=("neg|$neg_name|$neg_cmd")
done

TOTAL=${#WORKPLAN[@]}
step "logs: $LOG_DIR  jobs: $JOBS  mode: $MODE  tests: $TOTAL"

# FIFO-based bounded job pool. Each child reads one token from $SEM_FIFO
# before starting and writes one back on exit; only $JOBS tokens exist,
# so at most $JOBS children run concurrently. Opening the fifo in
# read-write mode (<>) means writes never block the parent. The fifo
# inode is unlinked immediately after fd 8 is bound -- the kernel keeps
# the pipe alive as long as fd 8 is open.
SEM_FIFO="$LOG_DIR/sem.fifo"
mkfifo "$SEM_FIFO"
exec 8<>"$SEM_FIFO"
rm -f "$SEM_FIFO"
for ((sem_i=0; sem_i<JOBS; sem_i++)); do
  printf '.\n' >&8
done

i=0
for w in "${WORKPLAN[@]}"; do
  i=$((i+1))
  w_mode="${w%%|*}"
  w_rest="${w#*|}"
  w_name="${w_rest%%|*}"
  w_cmd="${w_rest#*|}"
  read -r -u 8 _tok
  (
    run_one "$w_mode" "$w_name" "$w_cmd" "$i" "$TOTAL"
    printf '.\n' >&8
  ) &
done
wait
exec 8>&-

declare -A MODE_PASS=([marker]=0 [pc]=0 [neg]=0)
declare -A MODE_FAIL=([marker]=0 [pc]=0 [neg]=0)
declare -A MODE_SKIP=([marker]=0 [pc]=0 [neg]=0)
declare -a FAILED_NAMES=()
while IFS=$'\t' read -r r_mode r_name r_status _r_rc _r_el; do
  case "$r_status" in
    PASS) MODE_PASS[$r_mode]=$((MODE_PASS[$r_mode]+1)) ;;
    SKIP) MODE_SKIP[$r_mode]=$((MODE_SKIP[$r_mode]+1)) ;;
    FAIL) MODE_FAIL[$r_mode]=$((MODE_FAIL[$r_mode]+1));
          FAILED_NAMES+=("${r_name}[${r_mode}]") ;;
  esac
done < "$RESULTS_FILE"

# Stream failed-test logs in workplan order so the user sees a
# deterministic post-run failure dump.
for w in "${WORKPLAN[@]}"; do
  w_mode="${w%%|*}"
  w_rest="${w#*|}"
  w_name="${w_rest%%|*}"
  w_status=$(awk -F'\t' -v m="$w_mode" -v n="$w_name" \
                 '$1==m&&$2==n{print $3; exit}' "$RESULTS_FILE")
  if [[ "$w_status" == "FAIL" ]]; then
    echo
    echo "=== FAIL log: ${w_name}[${w_mode}] ==="
    cat "$LOG_DIR/$w_mode--$w_name.log"
  fi
done

echo
marker_p=${MODE_PASS[marker]} marker_f=${MODE_FAIL[marker]} marker_s=${MODE_SKIP[marker]}
pc_p=${MODE_PASS[pc]}   pc_f=${MODE_FAIL[pc]}   pc_s=${MODE_SKIP[pc]}
neg_p=${MODE_PASS[neg]} neg_f=${MODE_FAIL[neg]} neg_s=${MODE_SKIP[neg]}
total_pass=$((marker_p + pc_p + neg_p))
total_fail=$((marker_f + pc_f + neg_f))
total_skip=$((marker_s + pc_s + neg_s))
step "summary: marker ${marker_p}p/${marker_f}f/${marker_s}s  pc ${pc_p}p/${pc_f}f/${pc_s}s  neg ${neg_p}p/${neg_f}f/${neg_s}s  total ${total_pass} passed, ${total_fail} failed, ${total_skip} skipped"
if (( total_fail > 0 )); then
  fail "failures: ${FAILED_NAMES[*]}"
  exit 1
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# L20: fcsr (frm + sticky fflags) round-trips QEMU1 -> vsim -> drain.
#
# rt_c_fcsr sets fcsr=0x21 (frm=RTZ | NX) before the enter marker; the
# plugin must drain it (state file offset 3408, locked by
# state_abi_check.h). The vsim leg's in-ROI self-check exits 1 if
# ResumeDriver did not restore the value, then writes the sentinel 0x45
# (frm=RDN | NX|UF) that StateDrain must capture at the exit marker.
#
# Manual TDD smoke; not auto-wired into scripts/run_e2e.sh (the fixture
# itself runs there via the normal marker/pc suite).

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/paths.sh"
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

FIXTURE="${FIXTURE:-rt_c_fcsr}"
TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-120}"

hybrid_resolve_paths

SHARED_SIZE=$((128 * 1024 * 1024))
SHARED_MEM=$(mktemp -p /dev/shm vsim-fcsr-shared.XXXXXX)
STATE_QEMU=$(mktemp)
STATE_VSIM=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$SHARED_MEM" "$STATE_QEMU" "$STATE_VSIM"' EXIT
truncate -s "$SHARED_SIZE" "$SHARED_MEM"

read_u64_le() { od -A n -j "$1" -N 8 -t u8 "$2" | tr -d ' \n'; }
FCSR_OFF=3408  # locked by include/hybrid/state_abi_check.h

set +e
"$VSIM_QEMU" \
  -object "memory-backend-file,id=mem,share=on,mem-path=$SHARED_MEM,size=$SHARED_SIZE" \
  -machine andes_ae350,memory-backend=mem \
  -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512 \
  -nographic \
  -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
  -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,outfile=$STATE_QEMU" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
QEMU1_RC=$?
set -e
[ "$QEMU1_RC" -eq 200 ] || fail "QEMU 1 expected exit 200 on marker drain, got $QEMU1_RC"
[ -s "$STATE_QEMU" ]    || fail "QEMU 1 produced no state"

Q_FCSR=$(read_u64_le "$FCSR_OFF" "$STATE_QEMU")
[ "$Q_FCSR" -eq 33 ] \
  || fail "QEMU 1 drained fcsr=$Q_FCSR, want 33 (0x21: frm=RTZ | NX) -- plugin not draining fcsr?"
ok "QEMU 1 drained fcsr=0x21"

set +e
timeout "$TIMEOUT" "$VSIM_BIN" "$VSIM_ELF" \
  --resume-from-qemu "$STATE_QEMU" \
  --handoff-out "$STATE_VSIM" \
  --shared-mem-path "$SHARED_MEM" \
  --shared-mem-size "$SHARED_SIZE" \
  --shared-mem-base 0x00000000 </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
VSIM_RC=$?
set -e
[ "$VSIM_RC" -ne 1 ] \
  || fail "vsim leg exited 1: the fixture's in-ROI self-check saw fcsr != 0x21 (ResumeDriver not restoring fcsr?)"
[ "$VSIM_RC" -eq 200 ] || fail "vsim expected exit 200 (marker drain), got $VSIM_RC"
[ -s "$STATE_VSIM" ]   || fail "vsim produced no state"
ok "vsim in-ROI self-check passed (fcsr restored)"

V_FCSR=$(read_u64_le "$FCSR_OFF" "$STATE_VSIM")
[ "$V_FCSR" -eq 69 ] \
  || fail "vsim drained fcsr=$V_FCSR, want 69 (0x45: frm=RDN | NX|UF) -- StateDrain not reading fcsr back?"
ok "vsim drain captured the in-ROI fcsr sentinel 0x45"

echo "PASS e2e_fcsr_roundtrip"

`./andes-sim run --model hybrid --trigger marker|pc|icount` is the unified orchestrator (`./hsim.py run --mode simpoint` for SimPoint); `tests/e2e.sh` drives marker/pc internally. Each yields a cycle figure: kernel/window cycles = the vsim `mcycle` delta (`hybrid_state_v1::mcycle`); SimPoint reports the weight-combined `estimated_cycles`.

### Shared ABI (`include/hybrid/state_abi.h`)

`hybrid_state_v1` is the binary wire format exchanged between the QEMU plugin and vsim. It holds: 32 GPRs, 32 FPRs, fcsr, M-mode CSRs (mstatus, mepc, etc.), PMP (64 pmpaddr + 16 pmpcfg), and the V extension block (vstart, vtype, vl, vlenb, 32 vreg[], vxsat, vxrm, vcsr). `HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX=64` supports VLEN up to 512 bits. Multi-byte fields are little-endian (native on RV64 + x86-64 host); the format is not endian-portable.

Flags (`HYBRID_FLAG_RV64`, `HYBRID_FLAG_FP`, `HYBRID_FLAG_V`) gate which state blocks are live. The ABI struct is validated by `verilator/tests/hybrid/state_abi.test.cpp`.

input.new_string:
### F-ENG-03 - VLEN runtime check

- Status: mostly superseded by L11 (2026-06-12); residual below
- Type: behavioural
- Traces: FR-106, MR-A, MR-I
- L-id: L11 (F-T3.4)
- Description: L11 closed the main hazards: the wire format now carries
  VLEN up to 1024 (`HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX=128`, state version 2), the
  plugin ABORTS on an over-ceiling vlenb instead of clamping
  (`hybrid_v_drain_policy`), vsim's `load_state` rejects an over-ceiling
  file, and inside `andes-sim run` the two legs cannot disagree because
  the fast leg's `-cpu vlen=` is copied from the engine descriptor.
  `LIVE_VLEN_BYTES=64` in `checkpoint.py` is NOT the wire ceiling: it is
  the live engine's vlenb used by the replay-archive validator, so it
  stays 64 for the VLEN-512 build.
- Residual: hand-driven legs (raw QEMU + raw vsim, both under the ceiling
  but different from each other, e.g. 1024 vs 512) are still only caught
  by the fixture's own self-check, not by a vsim-side compare of the
  live hart `vlenb` against `state.vlenb` at resume.
- Key files: `verilator/src/hybrid/resume_driver.hpp` (read live vlenb,
  compare against `state.vlenb`)
- Dependencies: none
- TDD RED: a vlenb=128 state file against a VLEN-512 sim aborts at resume
  instead of silently corrupting the V regfile.

python3 << 'EOF'
import json

path = 'docs/andes_sim_limitations.ipynb'
nb = json.load(open(path))

def cell_src(i):
    return ''.join(nb['cells'][i]['source'])

def set_src(i, s):
    nb['cells'][i]['source'] = s.splitlines(keepends=True)

# --- cell 6: reserved line + version note ---
s = cell_src(6)
old = "- `reserved[208]` = room for ~26 more `uint64` before a v2 layout is needed"
new = ("- `reserved[208]` = room for ~26 more `uint64` (wire format is version 2\n"
       "  since L11 widened `vreg[]` to 128 bytes per register)")
assert old in s, 'cell6 anchor'
set_src(6, s.replace(old, new))

# --- cell 13: rewrite the L11 section ---
s = cell_src(13)
start = s.find('### L11.')
end = s.find('### L12.')
assert start != -1 and end != -1, 'cell13 anchors'
l11_new = """### L11. [RESOLVED 2026-06-12: ceiling raised to VLEN 1024, over-limit aborts] VLEN ceiling  (F-T3.4)

- Was: the wire format reserved 64 bytes per vector register (VLEN 512)
  and the plugin CLAMPED the drained bytes to that with no warning - a
  wider engine silently lost the upper bytes of every V register. The
  standalone fast model also hardcoded `vlen=512`.
- Now (supported range: VLEN 128..1024):
  - `HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX = 128` (`state_abi.h`), state version 2;
    every reader (driver `state.hpp`, vsim `state_loader.hpp`,
    orchestrator `abi.py`) rejects version-1 files loudly.
  - The plugin REFUSES to drain an over-ceiling vlenb
    (`hybrid_v_drain_policy`, `include/hybrid/v_drain_policy.h`) instead
    of clamping; vsim's `load_state` rejects an over-ceiling state file
    the same way.
  - Inside `andes-sim run` the legs still cannot disagree (descriptor
    sync, unchanged). A standalone fast run overrides the built-in
    `vlen=512` via the passthrough tail:
    `andes-sim run --model fast app.elf -- -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=1024`
    (the last `-cpu` wins).
- Tests: `tests/hybrid/e2e_vlen1024_drain.sh` (QEMU leg at vlen=1024
  drains vlenb=128 with the full 128-byte register intact + the fast
  standalone override); fixture `tests/fixtures/rt_c_v_fill.c`
  (whole-register fill, in-ROI self-check; runs in the marker/pc
  suites); unit cases in `state_abi.test.cpp`, `v_drain_policy.test.cpp`,
  `state_loader.test.cpp`. Hybrid round-trip exercised at VLEN 128
  (`vsim:ax66_makatau`) and VLEN 512 (`vsim:ax45mpv_premium`, with
  `--verify`).
- Residual (tracked as ROADMAP F-ENG-03): hand-driven legs at two
  DIFFERENT under-ceiling VLENs are caught only by the fixture
  self-check; a vsim-side compare of the live hart vlenb against
  `state.vlenb` at resume is still open. No in-tree RTL config at VLEN
  1024 is built today, so the 1024 case is validated on the QEMU leg.
- Status: RESOLVED (2026-06-12) for the supported range 128..1024.

"""
set_src(13, s[:start] + l11_new + s[end:])

# --- cell 16: quickref row ---
s = cell_src(16)
old = '| L11 | VLEN ceiling 512, over-limit clamp silent | medium | partial |'
new = '| L11 | VLEN ceiling 1024; over-limit aborts loudly | medium | resolved |'
assert old in s, 'cell16 anchor'
set_src(16, s.replace(old, new))

# --- cell 17: re-check note ---
s = cell_src(17)
old = 'engines\n> are drop-in with VLEN synced from the descriptor (L10/L11);'
new = ('engines\n> are drop-in with VLEN synced from the descriptor, and L11 is now\n'
       '> resolved (2026-06-12): the wire format carries VLEN 128..1024 and an\n'
       '> over-ceiling vlenb aborts loudly instead of truncating (L10 partial);')
assert old in s, 'cell17 anchor'
set_src(17, s.replace(old, new))

json.dump(nb, open(path, 'w'), indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
print('patched cells 6, 13, 16, 17')
EOF

content, not just the completion status. Related: [[qemu-timeout-sigttou]]

content.text:
L11 is resolved for the adjusted scope: VLEN 128..1024, with over-limit failing loudly instead of truncating. All validation is green. Not committed yet.

**What changed**

- **Wire format** (`state_abi.h`): `HYBRID_VLEN_BYTES_MAX` 64 -> 128 (VLEN 1024), `HYBRID_STATE_VERSION` 1 -> 2. The struct grows 3624 -> 5672 bytes; since every field after `vreg[]` shifts, the version bump makes all three readers (driver, vsim `load_state`, Python `abi.py`) reject stale files loudly.
- **Silent clamp removed**: `hybrid_v_drain_policy` now returns ABORT when vlenb exceeds the ceiling; the plugin prints which limit was hit and exits 2 instead of dropping the upper bytes. vsim's `load_state` rejects an over-ceiling state file the same way.
- **QEMU**: no fork change needed - upstream `RV_VLEN_MAX` is already 1024. (I had bumped it to 2048 before your scope change; it is reverted and `cpu.h` is byte-clean against the submodule.)
- **Fast standalone**: covers the range through the existing passthrough - `andes-sim run --model fast app.elf -- -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=1024` (last `-cpu` wins; verified and pinned by the new smoke). No new flag.
- **New tests**: fixture `rt_c_v_fill.c` (fills v8 across all vlenb bytes, in-ROI self-check) wired into the e2e suite, plus `tests/hybrid/e2e_vlen1024_drain.sh` (QEMU leg at vlen=1024 drains vlenb=128 with the full register intact - the old ceiling would zero bytes 64..127). One TDD catch along the way: the fixture's first version failed because the inline asm lacked an early-clobber (`=&r`), so `vsetvli` overwrote the fill pattern - the drain itself was never wrong.
- **Mirrors/offsets**: `abi.py` updated (this also fixed an L20 leftover - it was missing the `fcsr` field), warmup/fcsr offsets in `tests/e2e.sh` and the fcsr smoke moved to 5440/5448/5456.

**Validation**: 14 host unit suites, 9/9 driver suites, e2e 39/39 (marker + pc + negative, including the new fixture), fcsr smoke, vlen1024 smoke, `--verify` state-diff PASS (110 fields) at VLEN 512, hybrid round-trip at VLEN 128 on `vsim:ax66_makatau` (descriptor sync drove the fast leg to vlen=128), parity 9/9.

**Docs**: notebook L11 entry rewritten as RESOLVED with the recipe + quickref row + scorecard note; CLAUDE.md and USER_GUIDE updated (supported range, override syntax, new offsets); ROADMAP `F-ENG-03` annotated - its residual is a vsim-side compare of live hart vlenb vs `state.vlenb` for hand-driven legs at two different under-ceiling VLENs, which the driver's descriptor sync prevents but raw legs don't. Also worth knowing: no in-tree RTL config is built at VLEN 1024 today (`ax46mpv_advanced` describes itself as 512), so 1024 is validated on the QEMU leg; the RTL side is exercised at 128 and 512.
